question_en: List the top 5 RAN4 specs by section count (largest specs).

semantic_evidence.finding: 'List ... specs' requests logical Spec identities. specNumber is the declared stable family identity, while release-specific node identities are not separate listed specs. ORDER BY sectionCount DESC, specNumber ASC
